current_splices.before:
error, invalid_stable_id, reject_native_unit_value, reject_reserved_host_id, require_bool,
    source_identifier,
current_splices.after:
error, invalid_stable_id, reject_native_unit_value, reject_reserved_host_id,
    require_bool_with_signature, source_identifier,

let return_unknown = return_unknown
                || signature_refusal::origin(program, template, function)
                    .and_then(|origin| origin.return_refusal(program, function, types, diagnostics))
                    .is_some();

check_expr_with_signature_view(
        program,
        current,
        expr,
        variables,
        functions,
        types,
        result_type,
        allow_moves,
        diagnostics,
        helpers,
        fused_producer,
        None,
    )
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub(super) fn check_expr_with_signature_view<'a, 'p>(
    program: &'p dyn ProgramSource,
    current: &'p Function,
    expr: &'p Expr,
    variables: &mut HashMap<String, Binding>,
    functions: &'p HashMap<&'p str, &'p Function>,
    types: &'p TypeTable<'p>,
    result_type: Option<&'p Type>,
    allow_moves: bool,
    diagnostics: &'a mut Vec<Diagnostic>,
    helpers: Option<&'a dyn crate::loop_calls::byte_writer::SourceHelpers>,
    fused_producer: Option<&'p Expr>,
    signature: Option<super::declaration::SignatureOrigin<'p>>,
) -> (
    Option<CheckedValue>,
    Option<super::recovery::RefusalView<'p>>,
) {

require_bool_with_signature(
        program,
        function,
        contract,
        variables,
        functions,
        types,
        result_type,
        diagnostics,
        kind,
        None,
    );
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub(super) fn require_bool_with_signature<'p>(
    program: &'p dyn ProgramSource,
    function: &'p Function,
    contract: &'p Expr,
    variables: &HashMap<String, Binding>,
    functions: &'p HashMap<&'p str, &'p Function>,
    types: &'p TypeTable<'p>,
    result_type: Option<&'p Type>,
    diagnostics: &mut Vec<Diagnostic>,
    kind: &str,
    signature: Option<super::declaration::SignatureOrigin<'p>>,
) {

let (contract_value, refusal_view) = match signature {
        Some(signature) => check_expr_with_signature_view(
            program,
            function,
            contract,
            &mut contract_variables,
            functions,
            types,
            result_type,
            false,
            diagnostics,
            None,
            None,
            Some(signature),
        ),
        None => check_expr_with_helpers_view(
            program,
            function,
            contract,
            &mut contract_variables,
            functions,
            types,
            result_type,
            false,
            diagnostics,
            None,
            None,
        ),
    };
